hero.title: Sadhna Singh
hero.description: I'm a Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience building scalable, responsive, and user-focused web applications using the MERN stack. I specialize in React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, and TypeScript, with hands-on experience in REST APIs, database design, authentication, and third-party integrations. I focus on writing clean, maintainable code and building reliable solutions that deliver a seamless user experience.
